tenantId.description: Entra tenant GUID that owns the subscription.

location.description: Azure region, for example eastus. Must offer the chosen VM sizes.

resourceGroupName.description: Created if it does not exist; an existing group must be in the same region.

namePrefix.description: 2-14 lowercase letters/digits/hyphens. All resource names derive from namePrefix + a short unique suffix.

uniqueSuffix.description: Optional 3-5 characters. Generated and remembered when blank. Cannot change after deployment.

deployedBy.description: Optional tag value. Defaults to your user principal name.

operatorObjectId.description: Optional Entra object ID granted Key Vault/Storage data roles. Defaults to the signed-in user.

operatorPrincipalType.description: Type of operatorObjectId. Anything other than User requires operatorObjectId.

domain.description: A DNS name you control, for example demo.contoso.com. Apps are served at cas/idp/hr/drupal/alumni/events/student.<domain>; a wildcard certificate is issued.

artifactTransfer.description: direct: no Storage account or Key Vault; artifacts go through the VM command channel and a private peer-only handoff (works where policy forces those services private; Contributor is enough). storage: use Storage and Key Vault with RBAC (needs role-assignment permission and public endpoints). Cannot change after deployment.

mode.description: manual: the script prints records and waits. azureDns: the script creates records in an Azure DNS zone you can write to.

acceptLetsEncryptTerms.description: Must be true. Accepts the Let's Encrypt Subscriber Agreement for the certificate requested on your behalf.

contactEmail.description: Optional ACME account email for expiry notices.

allowedHttpsSources.description: IPv4 addresses/CIDRs allowed to reach HTTPS (443). Use 0.0.0.0/0 only if public access is intended.

vnetPrefix.description: First two octets of the private /16 network.

dataServiceDefaultAction.description: Network default for Storage and Key Vault (Entra RBAC and TLS are always required).

dataServiceAllowedCidrs.description: Required when dataServiceDefaultAction is Deny: your public IPs, including any machine that runs this script.

failOnTestFailure.description: When false, failing browser tests are reported as warnings after a successful deployment.

tags.description: Extra tags applied to the resource group and resources.
